g.text: Fire Safety Essentials for IT Technicians
Mnemonic: "Awesome Bears Can Destroy Kitchen Fires" (A, B, C, D, K)
Materials: Wood, paper, cloth, cardboard, plastics
Most common type. Water-based extinguishers effective. Standard office fires.
Materials: Grease, gasoline, oil, solvents, paint, alcohol
NEVER use water (spreads fire). Use CO2 or dry chemical extinguishers.
Materials: Energized electrical equipment - servers, UPS, switches, PDUs, monitors
NEVER use water! Use CO2 extinguisher. De-energize equipment first if possible.
Once power is removed, an electrical fire becomes Class A or B.
Materials: Magnesium, titanium, sodium, lithium, potassium
Industrial settings. Specialized dry powder extinguisher. Rare in IT.
Class K - Cooking Oils and Fats
Materials: Cooking oils, animal fats, vegetable fats in commercial fryers
Commercial kitchens only. Wet chemical extinguisher. Not typical in IT.
PASS Method - How to Use a Fire Extinguisher
